summary: Fresh independent canonical audit of all 219 Chinese units, 22 temporal or active-hint items, and four people after the Jinshi 052 curation. The prior full-reign biography error is absent: the Hailing, Shizong, and Zhangzong institutional attributions now remain explicit unresolved contexts rather than personal intervals. Direct chapter evidence remains intact for Shizong in Dading 1–2 (AD 1161–1162) and Dading 4 (AD 1164), Zhangzong in Dading 29 (AD 1189), and Xizong in Huangtong 8 (AD 1148). The chapter cannot date the three institutional contexts further, so this complete review records them as research holds rather than granting date approval.

findings.action: Retain the current explicit unresolved contexts and research-required hint. Do not infer a personal active range; only independently sourced, person-specific chronology may resolve these holds in a later audit.
